summary: Maase Inc. filed Form 6-K to present pro forma financials reflecting a series of completed transactions: stock acquisitions of Real Prospect (98,002,174 Class A shares at $1.50/share) and Carve Group (195,894,609 shares at $1.50/share); cash disposal of Puyi Group for RMB70 million; deconsolidation of AIFU after its share issuance diluted Maase's ownership to ~7.85%; and acquisition of Time Good. No deal terms are specified beyond the stated consideration and dilutive event; pro forma financials cover multiple periods. This filing is informational; no pending deals to watch, though the dilution and disposal mark a strategic shift.
